scope: All sampled triples selected by predeclared SHA ranking independent of outcomes
All three designated candidates and two nonoverlapping fixed blocks retained
Closed independent square is the declared audit relaxation; exact physical transformed completion domain not identified
Rows use latency/(latency+100ms), a different scientific objective
All arithmetic exact Fraction; expectation over policy branches, not Monte Carlo
Client policies see only received prefixes; source tables passed only to the server
Subcatalogues and row blocks reuse old data; no new physical trials, heldout test or independent replications
No claim of whole-catalogue empirical superiority, deployed service, radio energy savings or historical priority
